> "Read session a4d75296-fc89-44b1 for me""},{"id":"p25s1","text":"and the model reaches for `agent_session_search`, `agent_session_list`, or `agent_session_read` on i"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" model reaches for `agent_session_search`, `agent_session_list`, or `agent_session_read` on its own."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Tool reference"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### `agent_session_search`"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Full-text search across all DSH sessions, each hit carrying its best-matching snippet."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Two engines, picked automatically — see Search on a stock profile."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The plugin is a thin layer over the harness's `sessionQuery` service — no parsing, no indexing, no c"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"thin layer over the harness's `sessionQuery` service — no parsing, no indexing, no cache of its own:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **`searchSessions()`** — FTS5 full-text search; backs the `engine: "index"` path of `agent_session"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"_search`. **Optional**: present only on the SQLite backend, and only usable when that backend has se"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"arch enabled. Always called behind a capability check.
- **`listSessions()`** — the full session lis"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"t in deterministic newest-first order; backs `agent_session_list` and the `engine: "scan"` fallback."},{"id":"p34s5","text":"
- **`filterEvents()`** — flat, pre-extracted per-event text; backs `agent_session_read`'s event con"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"tent and, with a `text` filter, the scan fallback's matching.
- **`filterSessions()`** — a safe exis"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"tence check by id (returns `[]` rather than throwing for an unknown id); used by `agent_session_read"},{"id":"p34s8","text":"` before it tries to fetch content.
- **`readTitle()`** / **`readTitleSnapshots()`** — single and ba"},{"id":"p34s9","text":"tched title resolution. Session headers carry no title field of their own, so every tool that shows "},{"id":"p34s10","text":"a title resolves it separately through one of these."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"All access is read-only. The plugin creates no database, index, or persistent cache of its own — it "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"reads whatever `sessionQuery` already maintains."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **DSH only** — does not search Codex, Claude Code, PI, or OpenCode sessions (unlike dsh-session-se"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"arch).
- **Requires `sessionQuery`** — all three tools depend on it; there's no reduced-functionalit"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"y mode. If the service isn't injected, the plugin registers nothing rather than registering tools th"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"at would fail.
- **The scan fallback opens sessions one at a time.** `filterEvents()` works per-sess"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"ion and reads that session's whole log, so a search with no matches walks the corpus. `maxScan` boun"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"ds it, and `truncated: true` tells you when the bound was hit. Enable the index if your corpus is la"},{"id":"p37s7","text":"rge.
- **`agent_session_read`'s event fetch has no cancellation support** — `filterEvents()` doesn't"},{"id":"p37s8","text":" accept an abort signal in the underlying service, so an aborted read still finishes fetching before"},{"id":"p37s9","text":" its result is discarded."}],"truncated":true}
